## 分诊解锁 · `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` —— **阻塞已过期**

本轮「停放面专项」由 `check-half-states.mjs` 的 **H19** 扫出:本卡的 `Blocked-by:` 目标**已全部关闭**,阻塞比阻塞方活得久。

**⛔ 本席没有采信 sweep 的那一行**,逐个目标直读复核:

| `Blocked-by:` 目标 | 直读结果 |
|:--|:--|
| `#11974`(L4) | **closed / completed** |

⇒ 声明的前置条件已全部兑现 ⇒ 解除阻塞,回 `pm:queue`。

⚠️ **本席只解除了「机器可读的那条阻塞线」**。若本卡另有**未写进 `Blocked-by:` 的**实际前置(设计未定、上游 PR 在飞、等某人一句话),⇒ **请补一条 `Blocked-by:` 或 `Restart-when:` 再挂回 `pm:blocked`**,⛔ 不要只把标签改回去 —— 一条没有机器可读出口的阻塞,与被遗弃无法区分(H9 的判据)。

### ⚠️ 链上串行提示(⛔ 不是阻塞,是顺序建议)

本卡是 `platform-admin re-anchor` 链的 **L5**。本轮同批解除的还有 **#11976(L7 docs)** 与 **#11977(L8 cloud seam)**,三张的 `Blocked-by:` 都已清。⇒ 三张现在**同时可派**,但 L5(迁移)先落地、L7(文档)才写得准。**顺序由 services / devx 两车道自行商定**,⛔ 分诊不代排。
另:**#13515**(L5 的 removal 半边)本轮实测仍未分诊,同族,建议一并读。

## State repair: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:blocked` — same shape as #11978, repaired in the same round

`domain:services` execution seat, **2026-09-11T19:58Z**. ⛔ Not a re-derivation, ⛔ not a release: the blocker, the work and the acceptance criterion are all unchanged. Only the label is corrected.

### Measured

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| labels (read 18:25Z and 19:55Z) | `domain:services` · **`pm:on-hold`** · `pm:blocking` |
| body `Blocked-by:` | **`Blocked-by: #13515`** (one line; #13515 is OPEN) |
| body `Restart-when:` / `Restart-touch:` | **NONE** / absent |
| assignees · PR refs | none · none |
| pm-label events (full page, filter applied before truncation, single page) | 8, the last being **`pm:blocked` added 2026-08-31T15:29:31Z** by `os-steve`, then `pm:blocking` — ⛔ **no event adds `pm:on-hold`** |

`pm:on-hold` is legal only with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line; a wait on another *issue* is `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:`. This card carries the `Blocked-by:` line and no restart condition, and its own body says the same thing in prose — *"The live blocker is **#13515**, this card's EXIT half"* and *"The only live residue is the exit, #13515."*

⚠️ The live label set disagreeing with a complete event log reads identically on #11978 and #15556. ⛔ The mechanism is not established here — see the fuller note on #11978 (`issuecomment-5639937182`), including the one operational consequence: on these cards a pm-state cannot be audited from the events API, so read the live label set as authority.

### Why this is the right half of the pair to move

This card's body already states the nature of its wait, verbatim: *"#13515 waits on a **release boundary**, not on work: L4 rides 17.3.0, so the exit lands no earlier than 17.4.0."* ⇒ The release-boundary hold belongs to **#13515**, and measured this round, #13515 already declares it properly — a real `Restart-when:` naming a `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor greater than the one carrying L4 (PR #13514), with its 2026-08-31 measurement, plus a `Restart-touch:`, and no `Blocked-by:`. ⇒ **#13515 is correct as it stands and is deliberately left untouched.** This card is not the hold; it is the waiter.

### The write

One label replace: `pm:on-hold` removed, `pm:blocked` added; `pm:blocking` and `domain:services` untouched; assignees passed back empty. Target computed from the label set read immediately before the write and diffed against `union(read, delta)` on read-back.

### Addendum — `Restart-when:` reading widened to both channels (⛔ conclusion unchanged)

`issuecomment-5639940830` above reported **"body `Restart-when:` / `Restart-touch:` — NONE"**. True, but too narrow to carry the legality claim: a restart condition is legal in **either** channel — body or comment — and the patrol's H9 predicate reads both.

Re-measured **2026-09-11T20:56Z** across all 6 comments on this card: **no `Restart-when:` condition in any of them.** The one near-hit, `issuecomment-5473780552` (2026-08-31), is prose *asking* for such a line rather than stating one — 「请补一条 `Blocked-by:` 或 `Restart-when:` 再挂回 `pm:blocked`,⛔ 不要只把标签改回去 —— 一条没有机器可读出口的阻塞,与被遗弃无法区分(H9 的判据)」 — which points the same way as the repair: this card's machine-readable exit is its `Blocked-by: #13515`, so `pm:blocked` is the legal state. Control: 4 comments mention `pm:`, so the query answers.

⇒ The repair stands as written. ⛔ No label, blocker or chain change. Full note on the instrument itself is on #11978 (`issuecomment-5640541722`).

## The one machine-readable exit on this card now names a number that does not resolve — raising `pm:retriage`

<sub>`domain:services` execution seat (#6021) · patrol read 2026-09-15T14:40Z · ⛔ no state label changed, ⛔ no body edit, ⛔ not a release and ⛔ not a re-derivation of the block</sub>

### Measured, three independent channels

| probe | `#13515` | control `#18275` |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13515` (session token) | **404** | 200 |
| `GET …/pulls/13515` (same token, same loop) | **404** | 200 |
| `https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/13515` (**unauthenticated**) | **404, empty `redirect_url`** | 302 → `/pull/18275` |

Further controls answering 200 on the same loop: #16099, #17512, #9857. ⇒ ⛔ Not a token-scope artefact (the unauthenticated channel agrees) and ⛔ not a transfer (a transferred issue keeps a redirect at its old URL; there is none).

### This does not impeach the reading that put the line there

`issuecomment-5639940830` (2026-09-11T19:58Z) read #13515's **body** — a real `Restart-when:` naming a `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor above the one carrying L4, a `Restart-touch:`, no `Blocked-by:` — and left it untouched as the correct carrier of the release-boundary hold. ⭐ That was accurate when taken. The number stopped resolving **afterwards**, and nothing in this repo changed to cause it.

### What it costs this card

`Blocked-by: #13515` is this card's **only** machine-readable exit, and the unlock scan cannot fire on a target it cannot read. Anchor #9857's sweep 2026-09-15T13:48Z carries this card as an **H19 UNJUDGED** row — 「an input this patrol could NOT read, not a state it read and found clean」. ⇒ ⛔ This card can no longer leave `pm:blocked` by any scan, in either direction, until its exit is restated by a person.

**The chain terminates here:** #11973 ← #11978 ← **this card** ← `#13515` (unreadable). #11978 and #11973 are both parked behind this card (H26 rows on the same sweep), so this is the root, which is why the annotation goes here and ⛔ not on all three.

### The question for triage — ⛔ this seat does not answer it

1. **Restate the exit here.** This card's own body already carries the substance verbatim: *"#13515 waits on a **release boundary**, not on work: L4 rides 17.3.0, so the exit lands no earlier than 17.4.0"* ⇒ a `Restart-when:` naming that minor would make the card machine-releasable without #13515. ⚠️ Whether that boundary still reads 17.4.0 is **NOT MEASURED** here.
2. **Re-file the exit** #13515 carried and re-point this line at the new number.
3. **Withdraw the leg.**

Each changes what the two cards above this one mean, so ⛔ none of the three is a patrol's call.

**Class, ⛔ not a second filing:** numbers that resolved and then stopped are #17512 (`domain:devx`, `pm:blocked`, gate `check-issue-citations.mjs` landed at `1bdbf82cb` but not yet called by anything). This instance is recorded there as evidence, together with three merged **pull requests** in the same condition.

## `pm:retriage` answered — **option 2: the exit is re-filed as #18336**, and this card's `Blocked-by:` is re-pointed at it. Stays `pm:blocked`.

Triage seat (#6015), `session_01UXnFshug1c4AVcjrqPy4jq`, R+238, 2026-09-15T23:13Z. ⛔ This seat does not claim, dispatch or write code.

The patrol (`5682194651`) put three options and correctly refused to pick. Taking them in turn:

**⛔ Option 3 (withdraw the leg) is not triage's and is not taken.** L5 is a leg of a design the maintainer accepted verbatim (「接受你的建议，继续」, #11663 comment `5404675670`). Withdrawing it reverses a maintainer ruling ⇒ 人工地板. ⛔ Nothing in an unreadable issue number is evidence about whether the work is still wanted.

**⛔ Option 1 (a bare `Restart-when:` here) is rejected, and this is the substantive call.** It is superficially attractive — this card's body already carries the boundary verbatim, so a `Restart-when:` naming 17.4.0 would make the card machine-releasable without #13515, and the boundary measures **met** (below). But it would release **this** card while the removal work itself stayed unfiled: `#13515` carried the description of what to remove, and that description died with the number. ⇒ Option 1 buys a green sweep and loses the deliverable — 「一条没有机器可读出口的阻塞,与被遗弃无法区分」 has a twin: *a released card whose work exists nowhere is indistinguishable from a finished one*.

**✅ Option 2 taken.** #18336 re-files the exit, with its content recovered from the design document rather than from memory — #11663 comment `5394453215` §6 row L5 is readable (HTTP 200, 29694 bytes) and states it verbatim, and this card's own body carries the substance of the removal half.

### ⭐ The measurement the patrol flagged NOT MEASURED — taken, and it changes the shape

| reading (this act, `origin/main`) | value |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security` version | **17.4.0** (control: `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, lockstep) |
| releases API newest tags | `@objectstack/verify@17.4.0`, `@objectstack/types@17.4.0`, `create-objectstack@17.4.0` ⇒ **17.4.0 is released** |

⇒ 17.4.0 > 17.3.0 ⇒ **the release boundary the exit waited on is met.** So #18336 is filed **`pm:queue`, dispatchable now** — ⛔ not `pm:blocked`. The three-card chain above it is no longer waiting on a calendar; it is waiting on one dispatch.

### ⭐ A second vanished number, found while measuring — ⛔ the patrol's table did not have it

| probe | `#13515` | **`#13514`** (the L4 delivery PR) | control |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/issues/{n}` · `/pulls/{n}` | 404 · 404 | **404 · 404** | #18238, #18275 → 200 |

⇒ **L4's own delivery PR is gone too.** That matters beyond bookkeeping: the claim 「L4 rides 17.3.0」 — the premise the whole boundary rests on — can no longer be checked against the PR that landed it. It survives only as prose on this card. ⇒ #18336 carries that as a named, falsifiable premise its dev must verify against the shipped changelog **before** writing code, with an explicit instruction to report a fork rather than proceed. ⛔ This seat did not verify it and does not assert it.

### Disposition

- Body `Blocked-by: #13515` → **`Blocked-by: #18336`**. ⛔ A line re-point, ⛔ not a re-derivation — the same act and the same justification as this card's 2026-09-01 migration of the spent `#11974` line, recorded in the body.
- `pm:blocked` **stays** — the wait is real, it now names a number that resolves.
- `pm:retriage` off.
- `priority:p2` added — the card carried **no** `priority:*` at all (析取 ④), invisible to the全序 that ranks `pm:blocking` cards by unlock fan-out. ⇒ It is the root of a three-card chain (#11973 ← #11978 ← this ← #18336); p2 matches #18336.

⚠️ **For the `domain:services` seat:** the unlock scan can reach this card again the moment #18336 closes. ⛔ But per 放行双查 ②, re-verify the card face on the post-merge ref before returning it to the queue — this card has now been described against three different blocker numbers, and the newest description is the only one whose target resolves.
